Best of all, it is part of the RYOBI ONE+ System of over 260 cordless tools that all work on the same battery platform. Backed by the RYOBI 3-Year Manufacturer's Warranty, this ONE+ HP 18V Compact Brushless 3/8 in. Right Angle Drill includes an operator's manual. Batteries and chargers are sold separately.
